label: Canadian Overnight Repo Rate Average (CORRA)
description: A measure of the cost of overnight general collateral funding in Canadian dollars using Government of Canada treasury bills and bonds as collateral for repurchase transactions (repos).

label: CORRA: total dollar trading volume of all trades eligible
description: The total nominal value of CORRA transactions before trimming the bottom 25 percent.

label: CORRA: trimmed dollar volume of trades eligible
description: The total nominal value of CORRA transactions after trimming the bottom 25 percent.

label: CORRA: minimum volume threshold
description: The minimum dollar volume threshold of trades eligible for CORRA. It represents the volume removed during the trimming process in the CORRA calculation.

label: CORRA: number of unique data submitters
description: The number of unique data submitters used in the calculation of CORRA before trimming.

label: CORRA: rate at which daily trading volume is trimmed
description: The rate at which the bottom 25 percent of CORRA volume was trimmed.

label: CORRA: rate at 5th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
description: The rate at the 5th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

label: CORRA: rate at 25th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
description: The rate at the 25th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

label: CORRA: rate at 75th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
description: The rate at the 75th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

label: CORRA: rate at 95th percentile of the trimmed trading volume
description: The rate at the 95th volume-weighted percentile of the trimmed trading volume. This is one of the transparency metrics published alongside CORRA.

label: CORRA: publication status
description: Indicates whether CORRA has been published for the given day.

label: CORRA: calculation methodology
description: Indicates the methodology used by the Bank of Canada to calculate CORRA based on transaction-level repo data.

label: CORRA: mean
description: The volume‑weighted average rate of eligible overnight repurchase transactions used in the calculation of CORRA.

label: CORRA: mode
description: The modal rate — the interest‑rate level with the largest traded volume among eligible CORRA transactions for a given day.

label: CORRA Compounded Index
description: A measure of the cumulative impact of CORRA compounding over time, starting from a base value of 100 on June 12, 2020. This index, provided for informational purposes only, can be used to calculate CORRA compounded between any two dates.
